Bridging Quality Education & Digital Innovation.

First-Class Educator Data Automation Specialist Full-Stack Web App Developer WEITECH Cohort 3 Graduate Google Cybersecurity · Coursera Global Schools Advocate Trainee

I graduated with First-Class Honors in Education (2023) — a distinction that reflected not just academic performance, but a deep commitment to doing the work properly, understanding it fully, and never accepting mediocrity. That same standard now drives everything I build with technology.

As an educator, I led intervention classes for learners aged 9 to 14 — students who needed differentiated support and someone willing to meet them where they were. That work sharpened my ability to identify gaps, design targeted solutions, and measure what actually works. I didn't just teach: I diagnosed, strategized, and iterated.

Teaching also exposed me to the systemic inefficiencies that technology could fix — endless paper trails, manually compiled report cards, error-prone tracking systems. I kept thinking: there has to be a better way. So I built one. And then another.

My goal is simple and ambitious: to sit at the intersection of education, data, and security — and design learning environments where every student is accounted for, every process is efficient, and every decision is data-driven.

Web Production
Full-Stack Terminal Report Portal
EduReport Pro · Junior High School Report Portal · Scholametric International School · Nsawam Eastern Region · Live on Vercel · Screenshot uses sample data
Problem
Traditional institutional record workflows are isolated to single local machines or vulnerable paper logs, completely breaking real-time visibility and risking permanent loss of student history.
Solution
Engineered a high-performance web application from scratch to transition isolated desktop metrics into a secure, cloud-based system — moving student records out of local machines and into a live, accessible platform.
Impact
Managed through version control on GitHub and deployed live to production via Vercel — scaling the school's grading ecosystem into a tamper-resistant, globally accessible web environment.

Automated Excel-to-PDF Report System
KAS Christian International School · Live production system · Screenshot and report use sample data
Problem
Term-end grading required manually tracking and inputting metrics across 13 individual classes, causing massive teacher burnout and exposing unencrypted files to accidental modification.
Solution
Developed a complex, logic-driven automation workbook applying institutional grading criteria — the exact data blueprint that directly inspired the transition into full-stack web engineering.
Impact
Hardened with secure range locks, script visibility restrictions, and an automated bulk PDF export engine actively saving teachers hundreds of hours of administrative friction per term.

Data Analytics
Automated School Bus Management Database
Problem
Loose, paper-based transit lists led to routing delays, accountability risks, and unsecured student and family logistics data with no audit trail.
Solution
Created a robust relational matrix that instantly cross-references and groups students by classroom lines, localized geographical pickup zones, and strict daily schedules.
Impact
Optimized morning fleet operations, completely removed logging errors, and protected sensitive domestic tracking profiles from unauthorized access.
Microsoft ExcelRelational LogicData ValidationRoute Modeling
Understudy Project
EdTech
3D Educational Manipulatives for Mathematics
Problem
Abstract mathematical themes like Place Value create cognitive bottlenecks for young intervention learners when limited strictly to flat 2D textbook pages.
Solution
Designed custom, interlocking Place Value math blocks inside Tinkercad — creating print-ready 3D models during an educational understudy with the edu3Dcation program. The designs are complete and ready for future 3D printing.
Impact
Transformed abstract numerical concepts into tangible, print-ready 3D designs — models that, once printed, will give intervention students aged 9–14 physical tools to hold and visualize Place Value for the first time.
Tinkercad3D Modelingedu3DcationIntervention Design
Live Production
Web Production
Full-Stack School Management System
Royal International School · "Success is Assured" · Live React app · Modules: Dashboard, Students, Teachers, Finance, Academics, Attendance, Announcements · Screenshot uses sample data
Problem
Schools managing students, teachers, finances, attendance, and academic records across disconnected paper systems had zero real-time visibility — data lived in filing cabinets, not dashboards.
Solution
Built a fully modular, role-based school admin portal from scratch in React and Tailwind CSS. The system centralizes student profiles (with unique SMI-XXXX IDs), class assignments, service tags (Bus, Feeding), parent records, teacher management, finance tracking, academic records, and attendance into one secure, searchable cloud interface.
Impact
School administrators at Royal International School can now search, filter, and manage all 17+ students across classes (Creche through Basic) in real time. Bus and Feeding service assignments are visible at a glance, parent contacts are linked to student records, and the entire system is accessible from any device via a live Vercel deployment — replacing scattered paperwork entirely.
React Vite Tailwind CSS GitHub Vercel Role-Based Access Cloud Database
